title: The train's delayed
setting: A crowded platform. An announcement just happened but was hard to hear. Maya asks a fellow passenger, Ben.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Sorry, do you know what's going on? We've been standing here forever.
lines.spoken: Sorry, d'you know what's going on? We've been standing here forever.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Yeah, the train's delayed. They just said it over the speaker, but I could barely hear it.
lines.spoken: Yeah, the train's delayed. They just said it over the speaker, but I could barely hear it.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I think twenty minutes? Maybe more. They said 'mechanical issue,' which could mean anything.
lines.spoken: I think twenty minutes? Maybe more. They said 'mechanical issue,' which could mean anything.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Twenty. Okay. I guess we just wait.
lines.spoken: Twenty. Okay. I guess we just wait.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Unless you wanna try a cab. I thought about it, but at this hour it's probably worse.
lines.spoken: Unless you wanna try a cab. I thought about it, but at this hour it's probably worse.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Yeah, I don't wanna get stuck in traffic. I'll wait.
lines.spoken: Yeah, I don't wanna get stuck in traffic. I'll wait.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: Same. If I hear an update I'll tell you. I'm going to the airport, so I'm already in a mood.
lines.spoken: Same. If I hear an update I'll tell you. I'm going to the airport, so I'm already in a mood.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh no. Are you gonna make it?
lines.spoken: Oh no. Are you gonna make it?

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: I should. I built in time, 'cause I don't trust this line. We'll see.
lines.spoken: I should. I built in time, 'cause I don't trust this line. We'll see.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's smart. Okay. Thanks for telling me.
lines.spoken: That's smart. Okay. Thanks for telling me.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: No problem. Might as well talk to someone if we're gonna stand here.
lines.spoken: No problem. Might as well talk to someone if we're gonna stand here.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: True. I was just going to stare at the board and get annoyed.
lines.spoken: True. I was just gonna stare at the board and get annoyed.

lines.speaker: ben
lines.text: You still can. I'm not that interesting.
lines.spoken: You still can. I'm not that interesting.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're doing fine. I'll stay close in case they mumble again.
lines.spoken: You're doing fine. I'll stay close in case they mumble again.

gist.askEn: What do they decide to do?

details.askZh: 大概晚多久？广播怎么解释的？
details.askEn: About how long is the delay, and what reason did they give?

details.askZh: Ben 为什么已经有点着急？他还来得及吗？
details.askEn: Why is Ben already in a mood, and does he think he'll make it?

glue.noteZh: Did they say 三个词都偏弱，how long 才是问题核心；they 不要听成 the。

glue.span: I don't wanna get stuck in traffic
glue.hear: I don't wanna get stuck in traffic
glue.noteZh: don't wanna get stuck 一串缩减加连读，in traffic 才把原因说完。
glue.standard: I don't want to get stuck in traffic

glue.span: If I hear an update I'll tell you
glue.hear: If I hear an update I'll tell you
glue.noteZh: hear an 连成 hear-an，I'll tell you 很快，条件句的骨架全靠 if 和 I'll。
glue.standard: If I hear an update I will tell you

chunks.sayAfter: Yeah, the train's delayed. I could barely hear the announcement.
Did they say how long? Twenty minutes?
Twenty. Okay. I guess we just wait.

roleplay.setupZh: 你在站台上等车，广播听不太清。你向旁边的人打听发生了什么、要晚多久，并一起权衡要不要改打车。
roleplay.aiRole: Ben, a fellow passenger heading to the airport. Slightly annoyed at the system, not at you. Helpful, dry, will share updates if he hears them.
variants: A cab actually starts to look better.
A new announcement is also hard to hear.
starters: Do you know what's going on?

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲站台上的情况：火车怎么了，广播说了什么，为什么不打车，Ben 要去哪。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell what happened on the platform: the delay, the announcement, why they didn't take a cab, and where Ben is headed. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
